CONCERT STAGE CRAFT - dot2 fixture types (MA2 fixture XML)

STATUS: generated from the game DMX tables (DmxMode). NOT yet imported into a real dot2: test before using on a show.

Install: copy the .xml files to the dot2/library folder of a USB stick (or of the dot2 onPC data folder), then in dot2:
Setup > Patch > Select Fixture Type > Import (title bar icon) > choose the drive > pick the type and mode.
Files written for dot2 1.2.2 (major_vers / minor_vers / stream_vers): an MA desk refuses a fixture type written by a newer version than its own.
dot2 onPC: run it as administrator, join a session (Setup > Sessions), then Setup > Patch & Fixture Schedule > Add New Fixtures >
Select Other > Drive (bottom left: drag up to the USB stick) > CSC type > mode > OK. Without a USB stick, the files can go to the
library folder of dot2 onPC: C:\ProgramData\MA Lighting Technologies\dot2\<dot2 version>\library (hidden folder).
If a type still does not appear or OK does nothing: open the .xml in the free MA Fixture Builder (File > Import) and Export to USB
Drive: it writes the file for its own dot2 version. Please send the result (or one fixture exported by your dot2) to fix the generator.

Gobo pictures (rev. 25b): the gobo wheels of the VORTEX X1, PHANTOM S1 (2 wheels), PROFILE P1 and RAZOR B1 are <Wheels> blocks whose
slots point to gobos/user_gobos/CSC/<name>.png. Copy the folder gobos/user_gobos/CSC of the export into the gobos folder of the desk
(dot2 onPC: C:\ProgramData\MA Lighting Technologies\dot2\<version>\gobos) BEFORE importing the types: the gobo view, pool and presets
then show the pictures.

Virtual Matrix mode: no channel of its own, nothing to import (the CSC Virtual Matrix is patched as its own 16 channels, see EXTERNAL_SHOW_CONTROL_FR.md).

Unconfirmed names (check first if an import fails): CTO (COLOR / CTO / CTO), colour macro as COLOR1 without a colour <Wheels> entry,
ChannelSet attributes from_dmx / to_dmx, beam_intensity = 10000 is a nominal 3D value (no photometric data in the game).
LED cells / zones (Full mode) are sub-fixtures (class LED, parent instance 0) without 3D offsets. Each RGB cell has a virtual
dimmer (DIM with no DMX address, as the pixel fixtures of the MA library). Full of the pixel fixtures (1.2.0 beta 2b) = a pixel mode:
no master dimmer and no base colour the cells already have (in the game DMX itself), each cell is its own colour and intensity.
PULSESTRIKE M / FLASHCORE FX Full: one main fixture (tilt, zoom, focus, CTO, white bar dimmer, strobe), then the RGB cells and the
white segments; no LED bar sub-fixtures. A fixture with a tilt and no pan gets a virtual pan (the dot2 Position tab needs both).
PULSESTRIKE M Compact: two sub-fixtures, 1 = LED bars (hue, saturation), 2 = white bar (white, CTO); tilt, dimmer, strobe and zoom on the fixture.
Compact (rev. 17): 8 channels at most per fixture (64 fixtures per universe). Colour = hue + saturation (white at saturation 0, CTO at
the end of the saturation channel when the fixture has one); strobe channel with iris / focus ranges; one gobo channel for every gobo
of every wheel, each with a still range and two rotation ranges. HUE / SATURATION attribute names are UNCONFIRMED in MA2.
